Accrual.description: Accrues a repo at its rate; no market model.
Accrual.detail: The repo value follows from accruing the cash and the security on the repo terms. No stochastic model and no volatility input are involved.

BGM.description: Brace-Gatarek-Musiela market model for forward rates.
BGM.detail: A LIBOR market model. ORE uses it in the range accrual pricer, which builds the model from the smile sections of the swaption volatility surface and prices each daily range observation.

Black.description: Black (1976) lognormal model on a forward.
